successCriteria.description: leave.model.ts defines LeaveRequestStatus enum with exactly five values: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED

leave.model.ts defines LeaveType interface with fields: id (string), code (string), name (string), description (string), isPaid (boolean), requiresDocumentation (boolean), isActive (boolean), createdAt (string), updatedAt (string)

leave.model.ts defines LeavePolicy interface with fields: id, policyName, leaveTypeId, entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxCarryoverDays, minRequestDays, maxConsecutiveDays, requiresDocumentation, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt

leave.model.ts defines LeaveRequest interface with all actor/timestamp fields: id, employeeId, leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, reason, status (LeaveRequestStatus), approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason, createdAt, updatedAt
leave.model.ts defines CreateLeaveRequestDto with fields: employeeId, leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, reason (optional)
leave.model.ts defines UpdateLeaveRequestStatusDto with fields: status (LeaveRequestStatus), actorId (for approval/rejection/cancellation), reason (optional, required for rejection)

leave.repository.ts defines ILeaveRepository interface extending IBaseRepository<LeaveRequest> with additional method findOverlapping(employeeId: string, startDate: string, endDate: string, excludeId?: string): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>

leave.repository.ts defines KnexLeaveRepository class extending BaseKnexRepository<LeaveRequest> and implementing ILeaveRepository, accepting Knex instance and tableName via constructor, with concrete findOverlapping implementation

All field names use canonical choices from ARCHITECTURE.md: leaveTypeId (not leave_type or leaveType), status enum values match domain design (DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED), rejection and cancellation fields all present
Jest unit tests exist at tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.repository.test.ts covering findOverlapping, CRUD operations, and edge cases

constraints: Files must be placed at src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts and src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts following the flat-file module structure
KnexLeaveRepository must extend BaseKnexRepository from src/shared/base.repository.ts and use its protected knex and tableName
No `any` types — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS.json constraint no-any)
All database access must go through the repository pattern — no inline SQL/ORM calls outside the repository layer
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks
outOfScope: Other domain modules: balance, policy, employee, notification, audit
